svg.desc: Mission Economique LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT The French Embassy in Egypt COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2008 24 mil EGP DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Construction of a smart administrative building, consisting of a basement and 3 floors, with an area of 800 m2 per floor. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered landscape design, architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.

g.text: and 3 floors, with an area of 800
